about: Labels for MapLibre render tests that differ by a decision. An entry names one test ("test", its id) or several ("pattern", a regular expression for ids), and has a "label", a "decision" and a "reason". The decision "wontfix" is a difference that the owner decided to keep, and only the owner adds one. The decision "later" is a feature that is not decided or not done yet. The first entry that fits a test gives the test its label. See "Render tests" in docs/development.md.

expectations.label: debug drawing
expectations.reason: The library does not draw collision boxes, padding lines, tile borders or the overdraw view (showCollisionBoxes, showPadding, showTileBoundaries, showOverdrawInspector). The owner decided on 2026-11-17 that it will not.

expectations.label: heatmap over an opaque layer above it
expectations.reason: MapLibre GL JS draws a heatmap over an opaque layer that is above it in the style. The library follows the order of the style. The owner decided on 2026-11-17 to keep this.

expectations.label: MapLibre miter overflow
expectations.reason: MapLibre GL JS stores the extrusion of a miter longer than 127/63 in a Uint8 (line_bucket.ts addCurrentVertex), so it wraps and the joins show notches. The library draws the full miter.

expectations.label: browser shapes complex scripts
expectations.reason: The browser shapes Arabic, Persian and Urdu text with its own fonts instead of the glyph files, so the glyphs differ from MapLibre GL JS while the lines and their order agree (see "Text" in docs/reference/maplibre-differences.md, on glyphs). The owner decided on 2026-11-24 to keep this.

expectations.label: line breaks in mixed scripts
expectations.reason: Mixed-script text does not break after a hyphen as in MapLibre GL JS.

expectations.label: line breaks in mixed scripts
expectations.reason: Mixed-script labels wrap into more lines than in MapLibre GL JS, and right-to-left text is not reordered per line after wrapping (#1795).

expectations.label: letter-spacing with Arabic
expectations.reason: text-letter-spacing is applied to a label that contains Arabic, which MapLibre GL JS leaves unspaced.

expectations.label: control characters and empty lines
expectations.reason: U+001C is drawn as a box (#1792), the empty line of two newlines is left out (#1793), and the line breaks (#1794) and right-to-left order per line (#1795) differ.

expectations.label: *-translate on the globe
expectations.reason: fill-translate, line-translate, fill-extrusion-translate, icon-translate and text-translate are not applied on the globe, with either anchor.

expectations.label: labels along lines on the globe
expectations.reason: Labels with symbol-placement line are not drawn on the globe.

expectations.label: heatmap on the globe
expectations.reason: The heatmap is drawn flat and is not projected onto the globe.

expectations.label: circle-pitch-alignment map on the globe
expectations.reason: Circles with circle-pitch-alignment map are not foreshortened toward the edge of the globe.

expectations.label: image source on the globe
expectations.reason: An image source on the globe is stretched toward the pole, and the area around the pole is filled.

expectations.label: custom layer on the globe
expectations.reason: A custom layer draws at another place and with another shape on the globe than in MapLibre GL JS.

expectations.label: tile zoom with terrain on the globe
expectations.reason: With terrain on the globe, a vector source uses tiles of a lower zoom than in MapLibre GL JS.

expectations.label: globe
expectations.reason: The edges of shapes differ by a pixel, or the collision boxes of collisionDebug are not drawn (see "debug drawing"). docs/render-triage-globe.md gives the cause of each test of the globe.

expectations.label: roll
expectations.reason: The camera has no roll: setRoll and the camera option roll have no effect.

expectations.label: atmosphere
expectations.reason: The globe draws the sky and the atmosphere (#920), but at zoom 13 with pitch 80 the horizon and the fog on 3D terrain differ from MapLibre GL JS (31% of pixels).

expectations.label: pitch above 90 with 3D terrain
expectations.reason: At pitch 95 with the center 1500 m high, the camera is below the plane of the center, and the level of detail of the tiles (the camZ term of coveringTiles in src/geo.ts) picks z14 to z16 tiles on the near face of the mountain, where MapLibre GL JS draws z12 and z13. The shape of the mountain and the skyline match.

expectations.label: MLT
expectations.reason: MapLibre Tiles (MLT) are not available.

expectations.label: line-gradient with line-dasharray
expectations.reason: line-gradient together with line-dasharray is not drawn as in MapLibre GL JS.

expectations.label: line-blur for each feature
expectations.reason: line-blur that is different for each feature is not applied.

expectations.label: circle stroke and blur for each feature
expectations.reason: Circle stroke and blur that are different for each feature are not applied.

expectations.label: text-writing-mode
expectations.reason: text-writing-mode is not read, so vertical labels are drawn horizontally.

expectations.label: text-pitch-alignment
expectations.reason: text-pitch-alignment map is drawn with the slant at the anchor of the label, which is an approximation of MapLibre GL JS.

expectations.label: projections other than mercator and globe
expectations.reason: Projections other than mercator, globe and vertical-perspective are not available.

expectations.label: fill-extrusion-pattern on walls
expectations.reason: The image of each feature is drawn, but on the walls it does not continue across the edge of a tile as in MapLibre GL JS.

expectations.label: vertical-align in format text
expectations.reason: vertical-align in format text is not available.

expectations.label: pitch above 60 degrees
expectations.reason: The tests have a pitch of 70 to 80 degrees, and the cause of the difference is not known. The tile cover above pitch 60, which differs from MapLibre GL JS (#1045), is one candidate.

expectations.label: the expressions within and distance
expectations.reason: The expressions within and distance are not available. Each gives null and writes one warning.

expectations.label: symbol-height-offset
expectations.reason: symbol-height-offset and its anchor are not read.

expectations.label: fill-extrusion-rounded-corner-distance
expectations.reason: fill-extrusion-rounded-corner-distance is not read.

expectations.label: crossSourceCollisions
expectations.reason: The map option crossSourceCollisions: false has no effect: labels of different sources always collide.

expectations.label: line-gap-width for each feature
expectations.reason: line-gap-width that is different for each feature is not applied: the line is drawn without a gap.

expectations.label: heatmap-radius for each feature
expectations.reason: heatmap-radius that is different for each feature is not applied: the layer uses the default radius.
